From 1869 to 1873, he worked for Evarts, Southmayd & Choate, a law firm co-founded by William M. Evarts, Charles Ferdinand Southmayd and Joseph Hodges Choate. items.description: On day 1 of the Election Day job, tag the right truck.

items.description: On day 1 of the Election Day job, tag the wrong truck, then find nothing in the vault.

items.description: In the Election Day job, complete the heist in stealth and swing the votes to the republican favor on the Death Wish difficulty or above.

items.name: Yes, We Can!
items.description: Complete the Election Day job on the Death Wish difficulty or above.

items.name: Ghost Riders
items.description: Complete a heist while you and your four man crew are wearing one different difficulty mask each.

items.name: Praying Mantis
items.description: Collect 5 packages with the green mantis stamp on to earn a green crate.

items.name: Bullseye
items.description: Collect 10 packages with the yellow bull stamp to earn a yellow crate.

items.name: Eagle Eyes

items.description: Collect 25 packages with the purple snake stamp to earn a purple crate.

items.description: Earn one of each crate.

items.description: Modify the CAR-4 rifle with a Competition Foregrip, CAR Quadstacked Mag, and a Competitor's Compensator.

items.name: Point 'n' Shoot
items.description: Modify any pistol with a Pistol Red Dot Sight and a Flash Hider.

items.description: Modify any AK rifle with a Lightweight Rail, AK Slavic Dragon Barrel, AK Quadstacked Mag, and a Funnel of Fun Nozzle.

items.name: Build Me an Army Worthy of Crime.net
items.description: Equip the Golden AK.762 rifle.

items.name: The Man With the Golden Gun
items.description: Kill 6 Skulldozers using only the golden AK.762 rifle.

items.name: Lord of the Flies
items.description: Perform 50 headshot kills using any sniper rifle. Unlocks the "Asilidae" mask, "Carapace" material and "Bugger" pattern.

items.name: Arachne's Curse
items.description: Perform 100 headshot kills using any sniper rifle. Unlocks the "Tarantula" mask, "Insectoid" material and "Spider Eyes" pattern.

items.name: Pest Control
items.description: Perform 250 headshot kills using any sniper rifle. Unlocks the "Vespula" mask, "Bug Shell" material and "Venomous" pattern.

items.name: Seer of Death
items.description: Perform 500 headshot kills using any sniper rifle. Unlocks the "Sphodromantis" mask, "Hard Shell" material and "Wings of Death" pattern.

items.name: Far, Far Away
items.description: Kill 25 enemies from 40 meters using only the Thanatos .50 cal sniper rifle. Unlocks the "Tank Buster" Barrel for the Thanatos .50 cal sniper rifle.

items.name: Last Action Villain
items.description: Perform a headshot kill on enemies using only the R93 sniper rifle while zip lining. Unlocks the "Compensated Suppressor" for the R93 sniper rifle.

items.name: Triple Kill
items.description: Kill 3 enemies with one bullet using any sniper rifle. Unlocks the "Angled sight" for all sniper rifles.

items.name: Maximum Penetration
items.description: Kill 10 Shields by shooting through their shields using only the R93 sniper rifle. Unlocks the "Short Barrel" for the R93 sniper rifle.

items.name: Dodge This
items.description: Perform 10 headshot kills on Cloakers using only the Thanatos .50 cal sniper rifle. Unlocks the "Suppressed Barrel" for the Thanatos .50 cal sniper rifle.

items.name: Surprise Motherfucker
items.description: Kill 10 Bulldozers using only the Thanatos .50 cal sniper rifle. Unlocks the "CQB Barrel" for the Thanatos .50 cal sniper rifle.

items.name: Didn't See That Coming Did You?
items.description: Kill 10 enemies using any sniper rifle while zip lining. Unlocks the "Theia Magnified Scope" for sniper rifles.

items.name: Return to Sender
items.description: Kill 25 Snipers using only the Rattlesnake sniper rifle. Unlocks the "Tactical Aluminium Body" for the Rattlesnake sniper rifle.

items.name: You Can't Hide
items.description: Kill 25 enemies shooting through walls or objects using only the R93 sniper rifle. Unlocks the "Wooden Body" for the R93 sniper rifle.

items.name: Double Kill
items.description: Kill 2 enemies with one bullet 25 times using only the Rattlesnake sniper rifle. Unlocks the "Sniper Suppressor" for the Rattlesnake sniper rifle.

items.name: Public Enemy No. 1
items.description: Kill 250 enemies using only the Rattlesnake sniper rifle. Unlocks the "Long Barrel" for the Rattlesnake sniper rifle.

items.name: I Will Fade to Dark
items.description: In the Shadow Raid job, secure 4 bags of loot.

items.name: I Will Pass Through Walls
items.description: In the Shadow Raid job, secure at least 6 bags of loot and escape without killing anyone.

items.name: I Will Take With Impunity
items.description: In the Shadow Raid job, secure a piece of every available type of loot, including money, gold, cocaine, artifact, painting, weapons and server.

items.name: I Will Walk Faceless Among Men
items.description: In the Shadow Raid job, secure all 4 pieces of the samurai armor. Unlocks the "Somen Mempo" mask.

items.name: I Am Ninja
items.description: In the Shadow Raid job, secure 16 bags of random loot including all 4 pieces of the samurai armor.

items.name: I Will Die and Die, and Die Again
items.description: Complete the Shadow Raid job on the Death Wish difficulty or above.

items.name: It Takes Two to Tango
items.description: In The Big Bank job, hack the correct computer on the first try. Unlocks "The First American" mask, the "Parchment" material, the "Roman" pattern and the "Tactical Grip" for the Falcon rifle.

items.name: It Takes a Pig to Kill a Pig
items.description: Drop Floyd the pig on top of a law enforcer. Unlocks "The 1st" mask, the "Exhausted" material, the "Ruler" pattern and the "Extended Magazine" for the Falcon rifle.

items.name: Sweet Sixteen
items.description: Complete The Big Bank job with 16 secured bags. Unlocks "The 16th" mask, the "Clay" material, the "Spartan" pattern and the "Marksman Foregrip" for the Falcon rifle.

items.name: 12 Angry Minutes
items.description: In the Big Bank job, complete the heist in under 12 minutes on the Hard difficulty or above. Unlocks the "Wooden Foregrip" for the Falcon rifle.

items.name: Don't Bring the Heat
items.description: In the Big Bank job, complete the heist without triggering the alarm. Unlocks the "CQB Stock" for the Falcon rifle.

items.name: Backing Bobblehead Bob
items.description: Bring Bobblehead Bob to the vault. Unlocks "The 18th" mask, the "Gemstone" material, the "God of War" pattern and the "Wooden Stock" for the Falcon rifle.

items.name: Entrapment
items.description: In the Big Bank job, complete the heist with 12 bags in the default escape with all the lasers active. Unlocks the "CQB Foregrip" for the Falcon rifle.

items.name: You Owe Me One
items.description: In the Big Bank job, start the Big Bank job after having spent all 10 favors in Preplanning. Unlocks the "Retro Foregrip" for the Falcon rifle.

items.name: Don't Forget to Floss
items.description: Complete The Big Bank job on the Death Wish difficulty or above.

items.name: Funding Father
items.description: Complete any heist while you and your four man crew are wearing one different "Big Bank" mask each. Unlocks the "Marksman Stock" for the Falcon rifle.

items.name: Police Brutality
items.description: Beat a Shield to death using the Telescopic Baton.

items.name: Lock, Stock & Eight Smoking Barrels
items.description: Own the Locomotive, Street Sweeper, Reinfeld, Mosconi, Izhma, Raven and M1014 Shotguns. Unlocks the "Flip-up Sight" for the Raven shotgun.

items.name: Swing Dancing
items.description: Complete any single day of a heist, killing at least 50 enemies using only your melee weapon.

items.name: Seven Eleven
items.description: Get 7 enemy headshot kills within 11 seconds using any shotgun. Unlocks the "Short Barrel" for the M1014 shotgun, "John" mask, "Explosive" material and "Terror" pattern.

items.name: Shotguns 101
items.description: Complete any heist by killing at least 50 enemies and getting 101% accuracy or above using any shotgun. Unlocks the "Long Barrel" for the M1014 shotgun.

items.name: Knock, Knock
items.description: Kill 50 Shields using any shotgun and slug ammo. Unlocks the "Collapsed Stock" for the M1014 shotgun.

items.name: Every day I'm Shovelin'
items.description: On the Nightclub job, kill 25 law enforcers using your shovel. Unlocks the "Short Barrel" for the Raven shotgun.

items.name: Clay Pigeon Shooting
items.description: Kill 10 snipers using any shotgun and flechette ammo. Unlocks the "Long Barrel" for the Raven shotgun, "Clint" mask, "Leaf" material and "Monkey Skull" pattern.

items.name: Shock and Awe
items.description: Hit 4 enemies simultaneously using any shotgun and HE rounds. Unlocks the "Solid Stock" for the M1014 shotgun.

items.name: Bang for the Buck
items.description: Kill 10 Bulldozers using any shotgun and 000 buckshot ammo. Unlocks the "Long Barrel" for the Street Sweeper shotgun, "Steven" mask, "Sparks" material and "Chief" pattern.

items.name: No Heist for Old Men
items.description: Complete any day of a heist in stealth with a Locomotive 12G shotgun modified with the "Silent Killer Suppressor" equipped. Unlocks the "Suppressed Barrel" for the Street Sweeper shotgun, "Rutger" mask, "Banana Peel" material and "Banana" pattern.

items.name: Four Monkeys
items.description: In the Rats job, complete the heist while you and your four man crew are wearing one different "Shotgun Pack" mask each on the OVERKILL difficulty or above.

items.name: Precision Aiming
items.description: Kill 25 Bulldozers using the Gewehr 3 Rifle. Unlocks the "Sniper Barrel" for the Clarion rifle, "Sniper Stock", "Sniper Grip" and "Sniper Foregrip" for the Gecko 7.62 rifle, "Precision Stock", "Precision Foregrip", "Precision Grip" and the "DMR Kit" for the Gewehr 3 rifle as well as the "Black Death" mask.

items.name: Big Bada Boom
items.description: Kill at least four enemies with one GL40 grenade launcher shot. Unlocks the "Sawed-off" Stock for the GL40 grenade launcher and the "Crow Goblin" mask.

items.name: Army of One
items.description: Equip the GL40 grenade launcher, the Locomotive 12G shotgun, and the Improved Combined Tactical Vest. Unlocks the "CQB Foregrip" and "Plastic Stock" for the Gecko 7.62 rifle.

items.name: So Many Choices
items.description: Own one of every Gage Assault Pack weapon in the game. Unlocks the "Short Barrel" for the Clarion rifle, "Light Stock" for the Gecko 7.62 rifle, "Plastic Foregrip" and "Assault Kit" for the Gewehr 3 rifle, "Evil" material and "Vicious" pattern.

items.name: Artillery Barrage
items.description: Kill 25 enemies at 40 meters or more using only the GL40 grenade launcher. Unlocks the "Wooden Stock" for the Gecko 7.62 rifle, "Pirate Barrel" for the GL40 grenade launcher, "Bone" material and "Muerte" pattern.

items.name: Unusual Suspects
items.description: In the Watchdogs job, complete the heist while you and your four man crew are wearing one different Assault Pack mask each on the OVERKILL difficulty or above. Unlocks the "Light Foregrip" for the Gecko 7.62 rifle, "Tactical Foregrip" for the Gewehr 3 rifle, "Long Barrel" for the Clarion rifle, "Void" material and "Death" pattern.

items.name: Not Today
items.description: Kill a jumping Cloaker using the GL40 grenade launcher. Unlocks the "Wooden Stock", "Retro Grip" and "Wooden Foregrip" for the Gewehr 3 rifle.

items.name: Hammertime
items.description: Kill 25 thugs using the Ding Dong breaching tool melee weapon. Unlocks the "Frost" material and "Emperor" pattern.

items.name: Rabbit Hunting
items.description: Kill 10 Cloakers using the Gecko 7.62 rifle. Unlocks the "Skeletal Stock", "Fabulous Stock" and "Fabulous Foregrip" for the Gecko 7.62 rifle as well as the "Volt" mask.

items.name: Tour de Clarion
items.description: Kill 200 enemies using the Clarion rifle. Unlocks the "Suppressed Barrel" and "G2 Grip" for the Clarion rifle as well as the "Professor Wrath" mask.

items.name: Wrong Number
items.description: Complete the Hotline Miami job on the Death Wish difficulty or above.

items.name: Walk Faster
items.description: In day 2 of the Hotline Miami job, reach the Commissar's apartment in under 210 seconds on the OVERKILL difficulty or above. Unlocks the "Rasmus" mask, "Tactical Foregrip" and the "Ergonomic Stock" for the Uzi submachine gun, "Chromescape" material and "Palmtrees" pattern.

items.name: Do You Like Hurting Other People?
items.description: In the Hotline Miami job, kill 30 thugs with the Baseball Bat. Unlocks the "Dennis" mask, "Solid Stock" for the Uzi submachine gun, "Wooden Grip" for the Cobra submachine gun, "Rubber" material and "Hip to Be Polygon" pattern.

items.name: Overdose
items.description: Cook and secure six bags of meth on day 1 of the Hotline Miami job. Unlocks the "Graham" mask, "Ghetto Blaster", "Extended Mag" and "Just Bend It" for the Blaster 9mm submachine gun, "Error" material and "Be Somebody" pattern.

items.name: Sounds of Animals Fighting
items.description: In the Hotline Miami job, complete the heist while you and your four man crew are wearing one different Hotline Miami mask each on the Hard difficulty or above. Unlocks the "Silent Death" and "Folded Stock" for the Uzi submachine gun, "Suppressor" and "No Stock" for the Cobra submachine gun and "Short Barrel" for the Blaster 9mm submachine gun.

items.name: Phew!
items.description: On day 2 of the Hotline Miami job, save someone in need. Unlocks the "Aubrey" mask, "Ergo Grip", "Extended Mag" and "Unfolded Stock" for the Cobra submachine gun, "Sunset" material and "Doodles" pattern.

items.name: State of the Art
items.description: Complete the Art Gallery job on the Death Wish difficulty or above.

items.name: Why Don't We Just Use a Spoon?
items.description: Complete the Hoxton Breakout job on the Normal difficulty or above. Unlocks "Hoxton" as a playable character and the "Nova's Shank" melee weapon.

items.name: No Bars Can Hold Me
items.description: Complete the Hoxton Breakout job on the Death Wish difficulty or above.

items.name: Cavity
items.description: Hurt an enemy using the Nova's Shank melee weapon.

items.name: Sixth Nightmare
items.description: Complete the Safe House Nightmare job on the Death Wish difficulty or above.

items.name: Death From Below
items.description: Kill 25 enemies as they rappel using the Nagant sniper rifle. Unlocks the "Constable" mask, the "Silenced Barrel" and the "Long Barrel" for the Nagant sniper rifle, "Gunsmoke" material and "Dazzle" pattern.

items.name: Special Operations Execution
items.description: Kill 25 enemies while in stealth using the Trench knife. Unlocks the "Red Bear" mask, "Short Barrel", "Suppressed Barrel", "Short Mag", "Folded Stock", "No Stock", "Solid Stock", "Heatsinked Suppressed Barrel" for the Patchett L2A1 submachine gun," Barrel Sight 44", "Damper.L 44 Nozzle" for the Broomstick pistol, "Red Sun" material and "Death Dealer" pattern.

items.name: Wind of Change
items.description: In the Hoxton Breakout job, complete the heist while you and your four man crew are wearing one different "Historical" mask each on the OVERKILL difficulty or above. Unlocks the "Discreet Stock" and "Short Barrel" for the Nagant sniper rifle, "Precision Barrel" for the Broomstick pistol, "Extended Mag" and "Long Barrel" for the Patchett L2A1 submachine gun and the "Heatsinked Suppressed Barrel" for the Buzzsaw 42 light machine gun.

items.name: So Uncivilized
items.description: Equip a Broomstick pistol with the Damper.L 44 Nozzle and the Barrel Sight 44. Unlocks the "British Bulldog" mask, "High Capacity Mag" and "Holster Stock" for the Broomstick pistol, "Army Green" material and "Filthy Thirteen" pattern.

items.name: Bullet Hell
items.description: Kill 10 enemies within 10 seconds using the Buzzsaw 42 light machine gun. Unlocks the "Old Blood and Guts" mask, "Light Barrel" for the Buzzsaw 42 light machine gun, "Patriot" material and "Captain War" pattern.

items.name: Vlad's Little Helpers
items.description: Complete the White Xmas job on the Normal difficulty or above. Unlocks the "Mrs. Claus" mask.

items.name: Stealing Christmas
items.description: Complete the White Xmas job on the Hard difficulty or above. Unlocks the "Strinch" mask.

items.name: Cancelling Santa's Christmas
items.description: Complete the White Xmas job on the Very Hard difficulty or above. Unlocks the "Krampus" mask.

items.name: Claustrophobia
items.description: Complete the White Xmas job on the OVERKILL difficulty or above. Unlocks the "Mechanical Santa" mask.

items.name: Like Turkeys Voting for an Early Christmas
items.description: Complete the White Xmas job on the Death Wish difficulty or above.

items.name: Riders On the Snowstorm
items.description: In the White Xmas job, complete the heist on the Death Wish difficulty or above while each crew member wears a different "2014 Xmas" mask each. Unlocks the "Almir's Beard" mask.

items.name: Impossible, It Can't Be. Is It?
items.description: In the White Xmas job, secure the rare Almir's Toast.

items.name: Devil of a Job
items.description: Complete The Diamond job on the Death Wish difficulty or above.

items.name: Cat Burglar
items.description: In The Diamond job, complete the heist without triggering the alarm. Unlocks "The Cursed One" mask, "Sand" material and "Hieroglyphs" pattern.

items.name: Culture Vultures
items.description: In The Diamond job, secure 10 bags of additional loot. Unlocks the "Medusa" mask, "Rusting Metal" material and "Runes" pattern.

items.name: Smoke and Mirrors
items.description: In The Diamond job, steal the Diamond and escape in under 10 minutes. Unlocks the "Pazuzu" mask, "Diamond" material and "Horus" pattern.

items.name: Honor Among Thieves
items.description: In The Diamond job, complete the heist while you and your four man crew are wearing one different "Diamond Heist" mask each on the OVERKILL difficulty or above.

items.name: Diamonds in the Rough
items.description: In The Diamond job, complete the heist, diamond puzzle and steal the Diamond after the alarm has been triggered on the OVERKILL difficulty or above. Unlocks the "Anubis" mask, "Mummy Bandages" material and "Hawk Helm" pattern.

items.name: Tabula Rasa
items.description: In the Hoxton Breakout job, complete the heist on the OVERKILL difficulty or above with each crew member using no skills, wearing suits, wielding Golden AK.762 rifles and Chicago Typewriter submachine guns. Unlocks a new skill slot.

items.name: Knockout!
items.description: Knock out a Bulldozer using the OVERKILL boxing gloves. Unlocks "The Champ" mask.

items.name: Derailed
items.description: Complete The Bomb: Forest job on the Normal difficulty or above.

items.name: A Pine in the Ass
items.description: Complete The Bomb: Forest job on the Death Wish difficulty or above.

items.name: Beaver Team
items.description: In The Bomb: Forest job, cut down all trees within 5 seconds. Unlocks the "Butcher From Hell" mask, "Meat" material and "Pleter" pattern.

items.name: Pump It Up
items.description: In The Bomb: Forest job, do not let the cops disconnect the water hose while you are using the river water pump. Unlocks the "Tech Lion" mask, "Marble Rock" material and "Lion Game Lion" pattern.

items.name: Oppressor
items.description: Complete The Bomb: Forest job without letting any civilian flee or die, having at least five civilians in the heist, while escaping with the boat. Unlocks "The Doctor" mask, "Plywood" material and "Caduceus" pattern.

items.name: Maiden Voyage
items.description: Complete The Bomb: Dockyard job on the Normal difficulty or above.

items.name: Fisherman's Fiend
items.description: Complete The Bomb: Dockyard job on the Death Wish difficulty or above.

items.name: Sneaking With the Fishes
items.description: Complete The Bomb: Dockyard job in stealth on the Death Wish difficulty or above. Unlocks the "Lady Butcher" mask, "Rhino" material and "Checker Board" pattern.

items.name: Breaking Dead
items.description: In The Bomb: Dockyard job, find the meth lab. Unlocks the "Extended Mag" for the LEO pistol.

items.name: I've Got the Power
items.description: In The Bomb: Dockyard job, don't let the enemies cut the power. Unlocks the "Long Slide" for the LEO pistol.

items.name: Done in 60 Seconds
items.description: In The Bomb: Dockyard job, open the dock gate in 60 seconds using the keycards. Unlocks the "Custom Slide" for the LEO pistol.

items.name: OVE SAW 72000
items.description: In the Nightclub job, complete the heist on any difficulty with each crew member using the OVE 9000 saw as primary and secondary weapons. Unlocks the "THRUST Upper Receiver", "THRUST Lower Receiver" and "Long Ergo Foregrip" for the CAR weapon family.

items.name: Hey Mr. DJ
items.description: In the Nightclub job, have 12 hostages or more on the dance floor when you escape. Unlocks the "Aluminum Grip" for the AK weapon family, the "Aluminum Foregrip" for the Krinkov submachine gun and the "LW Upper Receiver" for the CAR weapon family.

items.name: $1.8M Speedrun
items.description: In the Mallcrasher job, loot $1,800,000 in loose cash within 50 seconds of starting the heist. The heist must be played on the OVERKILL difficulty. Unlocks the "Scope Mount" and "PBS Suppressor" for the AK weapon family, "Alfred" mask, "Dawn" material and "Dinosaur Skull" pattern.

items.name: Survivor
items.description: Every survivor deserves an Oscar. So it goes.

items.name: Chicken dielectric
items.description: An immortal Chicken on a stick makes an excellent dielectric. We do not recommend trying this in real life, unless you have an immortal chicken and an immortal you.

items.name: Artist
items.description: The artist can offend and draw anyone. Usually, this happens simultaneously.

items.name: Multilayer
items.description: It's warm in underpants, and you can hibernate in winter if you have a whole lot of them!

items.name: Sherlock
items.description: You can solve any case if you know for sure who you want to blame.

items.name: Small puffs of gas
items.description: It's indecent to fart on Earth, but farting in space can save your life by giving your body acceleration at the last moment.

items.name: The power of the Unicorn
items.description: You are immune to criticism. You are simply THE best. Everything your hands get to touch and create is GENIUS. This achievement is unique and is meant to be given to no one but you. Everyone else has a fake copy of it.

items.name: Trust me, I'm an engineer
items.description: Someone else's pass works just like someone else's diploma: it allows you to connect to engineering terminals and boast that you're a hacker while simply touching "Yes"/"No" on monitors.

items.name: Butthurt
items.description: The ignition of natural gas can cause not only a heated argument on some online forum but also a 20% increase in the flight speed with accelerators.

items.name: Dodger
items.description: When your life hangs in the balance, oxygen is left for one breath, the world is in danger, and death and suffering surround you — fly through all the rings!

items.name: Almost served
items.description: When you jogged for three days in a row, prepared yourself mentally to serve in the army, boasted that you were going to be a paratrooper, and then suddenly failed all medical tests — can this be considered as "almost served", or not?

items.name: Vacuum cleaner
items.description: The vacuum cleaner can not only help to clean the apartment quickly but can also rush through space and time like a jet motorbike. So convenient!

items.name: Destructor
items.description: Labor turned ape into a... more muscular ape. You have unique destruction skills, now your delicate workmanship with the handy scrapper will cause more damage to everything you touch with it.

items.name: Pollutionist
items.description: "It's a bad thing to destroy the whole garbage collecting infrastructure for selfish purposes," so my mother says. Although who cares, anyway? Isn't that a cleaner robot in the distance?

items.name: Driver
items.description: The dead people flying around are highly unlikely to say "wow!" to your highly polished brand new ZAZ but it's still nice to enjoy the ride with the wind... Or without it...

items.name: Electronic
items.description: If you mess around with electricity for a long time, you might get immune to it. Probably. But it's better not to try it.

items.name: Complete Chapter 2
items.description: Completing the second chapter will be almost as difficult as completing the third one. That's how it is.

items.name: Complete Chapter 3
items.description: Completing the third chapter will be almost as difficult as completing the second one. That's how it is.

items.name: Hacker
items.description: It would be an awful thing to open coffins if we weren't talking about their back panel containing the control panel. And since it's all about the control panel, then all is well, and you can proceed to open it.

items.name: A contributor to the industry
items.description: Congratulations! If you didn't cheat, then you are helping the industry to develop! In some way, not necessarily in the right one.

items.name: Mutagen
items.description: Scanning the dead product of genetic engineering will help the spacesuit to replenish its library of useless images. And it might be possible to sell these pictures to the newspapers if need be.

items.name: Psychiatrist
items.description: It's very easy to determine a person's mental disorder by the color of his spacesuit. Especially if you're a charlatan. A real professional will try to find and add all the other possible signs of the illness.

items.name: A rebel
items.description: You are a rebel at heart, a rebel by nature, and a rebel by horoscope. Down with other people's advice! Stick your fingers in…

items.name: Sharpshooter
items.description: It may seem that making a hundred or two shots is not so difficult, but when each shot is worth the cost of a whole space station, it's a completely different story.

items.name: Bandit
items.description: Attacking a security robot is a felony, even if no one saw you do it. On the other hand, it is still a felony, so there is nothing good about it.

items.name: Shepherd
items.description: It's really easy to herd cows in space: just pile them up in a heap and don't touch them until the rescuers come.

items.name: Heroic deed
items.description: There's no point in heroically covering a barrel of a beam weapon with your chest. You can, if you like, but in this case, it's just not necessary. If you really want to do it, don't forget to turn the weapon off first.

items.name: Coffin Counter
items.description: Finding and counting dead coffin robots is an interesting and extremely educational activity, although it's absolutely useless. If only there would be the living ones…

items.name: A Persistent One
items.description: If you press any broken button persistently, something will definitely happen. Maybe the button will break, or maybe even your finger.

items.name: The breathtaking!
items.description: Believing in yourself and never giving up, even when everything is useless and scripted, is breathtaking! No, you're breathtaking!

items.name: Undertaker
items.description: Living coffins are no joke. Some may think that such a situation isn't a big deal, but in reality, a dead thing being alive makes it a zombie, a zombie is a bad thing, a bad thing is a problem, a problem is serious, serious equals an investigator and an investigator equals a life sentence. In the end, do you really want to go to prison?

items.name: A menace to cows
items.description: Properly disposing of synthetic animal corpses, you can save humanity from dangerous diseases and the fertile soil from senseless pollution. You can also enjoy magnificent gore effects but that's not what matters.

items.name: Quick draw
items.description: Being the fastest is a real achievement! It's a real mastery! It deserves some respect! You hear, honey?! IT'S AN ACHIEVEMENT! =(

items.name: Machine gunner
items.description: Shooting a machine gun is easy. Hitting a target with it is harder. It's even harder to hit a target with the shuttle's plasma guns when the shuttle isn't designed for them.

items.name: Cartographer
items.description: Being able to orientate yourself is an extremely important skill for any traveler. Don't forget to mark the landmarks that are visible from afar, keep an eye on the moss on tree trunks, and don't forget about the North star and your compass. Especially, if you're not in space.

items.name: Think with your own head
items.description: One can listen to other people's advice forever, but it's much more valuable to think with your own head. You learn best from your own mistakes, as someone said... Or maybe they didn't.

items.name: The right choice
items.description: Sometimes, among a thousand of options, only one is the right one. It's amazing how you managed to identify it. The greatest minds will break their heads over solving this puzzle.

items.name: Toucher
items.description: A man's palms say more than the backs of his hands, elbows, or navel. If you want to appear a strong and hard-working man in the eyes of others, you can rub your hands to get calluses that will brutally scratch other people's hands when you shake them.

items.name: Voyeur
items.description: Spying on people is indecent, and spying on dead people is doubly indecent. Probably. The dictionary didn't say anything about it under the word "voyeur".

items.name: Wasted!
items.description: Not everyone can save the galaxy, but saving it by just sitting on the couch is beyond comprehension. Keep it up!

items.name: Airlock master
items.description: They teach astronauts how to dock to airlocks even before teaching them how to use the space toilet. Missing the toilet is unpleasant, but not fatal — missing the airlock is a problem.

items.name: Competitor
items.description: With all due respect to the work of repair robots, they are useless competitors that consume resources. These guys are not subject to reprogramming and will fix everything that gets in their manipulators: shuttles, the liner's debris, vehicles, killer coffins…

items.name: Pew-pew!
items.description: It turns out that if you bomb a liner, the anti-asteroid turrets go crazy. They go crazy by themselves, without any killer coffins' help. That's right. In any case, space will be much safer without them.

items.name: Saboteur
items.description: A quick and unexpected raid on the enemy's infrastructure is very effective, brave, and only a real space fighter is worthy of doing that. We can only hope that the coffins were really building these strange stations, and not destroying them.

items.name: Sir, no sir!
items.description: Someone always has to control an army, even if it's an army of crazy coffins. A coffin squadron without a general is just a bunch of stupid meat containers, and a coffin squadron with a general is also just a bunch of stupid meat containers, but with a general. That's a fact!

items.name: Ice breaker
items.description: It would be more correct to call this reward "An Ice-Shooter", but it sounds weird. In any case, the fewer unattended blocks of ice of questionable quality in space, the fewer people will be poisoned by poor-quality water in the future. Well, that's sanitary!

items.name: Careful driver
items.description: Either a very drunk, or a very meticulous pilot who wants to get a special achievement in his career would wipe all the asteroids in the area with a bottom of a space shuttle. It's up to you to decide, which one you want to be.

items.name: Big machine gun
items.description: It's fun to shoot with a blaster, but to shoot with big military spaceship blasters is a lot more fun. However, there is some bad news and some good news. The bad news is that shooting military weapons is prohibited without a license. The good news is that everyone who could have inspected this has already died.

items.name: Auto repair shop
items.description: A spring squeak, the smell of fresh engine oil, the noise of an angle grinder, and the fervent swearing of a mechanic — you can't find all this in outer space, and you never will. But what you can find is the creaking of your joints, the smell of fresh sweat, and the sound of blood in your ears. Space is a lousy place.

items.name: General
items.description: You have sought glory in ten single-player battles, fight on!

items.name: Centennial General
items.description: You have fought in one hundred single-player battles!

items.name: Millennial General
items.description: You have fought in one thousand single-player battles!  Even Alexander the Great did not have your strength of will.

items.name: First Victory
items.description: Congratulations!  You have achieved the first multi-player victory of many to come.

items.name: Fifty Victories
items.description: You have been victorious in fifty multi-player battles - you are a seasoned veteran and a worthy opponent!

items.name: Five Hundred Victories
items.description: It has probably been a long time since you stopped counting your battles and victories but your fans (and foes) will remember.  This battle marks your five hundredth multi-player victory!

items.name: Loyal Ally
items.description: On this day you have fought in your tenth online battle!  Let the town bell ring and the villagers rest from their labors that they may toast your good health and leadership.   There will be many battles ahead, some victories, some defeats - but always lessons.  Cheers and congratulations to you on this auspicious day!

items.name: Marking the First Hundred
items.description: Today is a day of glory!  You have fought one hundred battles versus fierce online opponents.  Three cheers for you - hip hip, HUZZAH!  HUZZAH!  HUZZAH!

items.name: Day of a Thousand Stories
items.description: Today is a day of great celebration!  You have fought your one thousandth battle against online opponents.  Order a feast!  Make a toast to those who have defeated you as honorable teachers, make a toast to those foes you have defeated, and most of all a toast to your friends and allies who have supported you in your many campaigns.

items.name: First Random Map
items.description: When you are ready to take on the unexpected you are ready to take on the world.  The Random map challenge is for any who are ready for attack or defense by land or sea and to defend against those who would threaten your empire.    Fight on!

items.name: One Hundred Random Maps
items.description: You are master of the random map - from the thrill of exploration, to the skillful deployment of your villages, to the razing of the enemy and driving them from your borders.  Master of continents and oceans, your leadership is the stuff of song and legend!

items.name: Anytime, Anywhere
items.description: You have fought on every type of map, against every type of opponent in history.  There may be those who will still stand against you, but they do so with respect.  Huzzah!

items.name: The Quickening
items.description: With turbo your villagers will gather and build quickly - pay attention to your resources and idle villagers. Turbo will let you focus more on your mid-game strategic planning.

items.name: Gathering Speed
items.description: Now that you have played twenty games at turbo you probably have a feel for the pace and challenges.  Focus on pushing your early attacks even earlier to surprise your enemy and interrupt their build momentum.

items.name: First Deathmatch
items.description: Deathmatch is a competition of fast decisions and instant action.  It will hone your skills at pitched battle.

items.name: Deathmatch Master
items.description: Mastery of deathmatch is the ability to continuously make good decisions while building a sustainable economy under constant attacks.  You have demonstrated that ability by playing 50 games.

items.name: Deathmatch Legend
items.description: After 300 battles if there is something to be learned in Deathmatch it is where to find opponents who will still agree to fight you.  Congratulations!

items.name: A Taste of History
items.description: Each legendary leader has something to teach you, a tactic, a strategy, or an attitude - when you have fought their battles and studied their history you are taking steps to becoming a legendary leader yourself.  Congratulations!

items.name: Twenty Scenarios
items.description: You have played your twentieth scenario, Congratulations!  What will the historians write about your battles?  Who were your greatest foes?  Were you more cunning or more bold?  Only time will tell.

items.name: Fifty Scenarios Completed
items.description: You have played fifty scenarios - Wonderful!  Each conquered world reveals more lessons and more challenges ahead.  All great leaders build their knowledge on the foundation of the stories of the legends that have gone before.   Cheers to you!

items.name: King of the Hill
items.description: It isn’t taking the hill, it is holding it against all attackers that is the ultimate challenge. You are on your way.

items.name: Ten Hills
items.description: Life is short and brutal but legend is timeless, if you can master the strategies of King of the Hill you will be better prepared to take on anything that life throws at you.  You have battled the hill ten times, this will certainly not be the last.

items.name: One Hundred Hills
items.description: You have claimed one hundred hilltops!  The victor isn’t often the first one to the top, but the one that knows how to hold it once they are there.  You have demonstrated that knowledge.  Cheers to you!

items.name: Peaceful Builder
items.description: Wonder race is an exercise in building an economy quickly and efficiently - pay attention to balancing your economy and tasking those villagers and you will be victorious.

items.name: Fifth Wonder Race
items.description: By now you know the shortest path to building a wonder quickly - and how to build up your economy in a hurry.  Focus on optimizing your gathering technologies and economy to surprise your opponents.

items.name: Wonder Race Mastery
items.description: For many, the Wonder Race is a good way to learn how to tune an economy and know the short path to the Wonder for any civilization.  For you, the Wonder Race has its own appeal - a celebration of the empire builder’s art.  Congratulations!

items.name: First Wonder Defense
items.description: Wonder Defense is an excellent way for any leader to build their skills.  If you are defending then you must build your forces and reinforce your defensive structures quickly or attack offensively to reduce your opponent’s strength.  Attackers must be coordinated if they hope to succeed.

items.name: Builder and Destroyer
items.description: Few things are so satisfying as seeing the enemy’s wonder in flames, or defending your wonder to the last unit.  After ten Defend the Wonder battles you have certainly seen both.  Cheers to you!

items.name: Wonder Defender
items.description: You have demonstrated mastery of the Defend the Wonder style.  Cheers to you on your fiftieth challenge!

items.name: You were the Most Valuable Player!
items.description: You have earned your first MVP award.  The Most Valuable Player in an Age of Empires II battle has the highest total buildings razed and enemy units killed on the team.  Aggressive attacks and thorough elimination of enemy buildings will increase your chances of earning additional MVPs.   Congratulations!

items.name: Rising Star
items.description: You have been selected for the Most Valuable Player award twenty times.  You have demonstrated great skill in battle, and surpassed that by outperforming the other generals in your allegiance.  You are definitely a rising star in this elite group.  Congratulations!

items.name: Incredible Team Leader!
items.description: You have been selected for the Most Valuable Player award 100 times.  You have demonstrated great skill in battle, and surpassed that by outperforming the other generals in your allegiance.  You are definitely a rising star in this elite group.  Congratulations!

items.description: Choosing ‘Random’ for your civilization is a good boast.  You are confidently telling the world that you can lead any civilization to victory!  Cheers to you!

items.description: After twenty five victories, you have shown that you truly can lead any civilization to glory.  You are truly a timeless commander!  (And you can probably converse with villagers in several languages.)

items.name: Random Civilization One Hundred Victories
items.description: After a hundred victories playing random civilizations, your reputation is truly secure.  Any civilization, any era, any map.  Just bring it!

items.name: Mysterious Foes
items.description: You have faced the unknown!  Playing against random opponents will expose you to a world’s worth of variety of units, tactics, and technologies.  Study their strengths and weaknesses to become a great leader.

items.name: Any Opponent
items.description: You have defeated random opponents twenty five times. Your legend grows greater with every victory.  Congratulations!

items.name: Random Master
items.description: You have faced the random opponents and defeated them two hundred and fifty times.  No civilization can find safety when they stand against you.  Congratulations!

items.name: Master of all Civilizations
items.description: You have won at least one victory against every civilization in Age of Empires II.

items.name: Skirmisher
items.description: You have killed over fifty units in  a single session.

items.name: Commander
items.description: You have killed over 500 units in a single session - your fame will spread from this point onward.

items.name: Emperor
items.description: You have killed over two thousand units in a single session.  You are a legend to both allies and enemies.

items.name: Just a flesh wound
items.description: Sometimes to win battles you have to make hard choices and sacrifices.   In this battle you lost 25 units to combat with the enemy.  Sometimes an outdated unit can get a needed boost of speed or armor with the right technology.   Get used to watching the alerts on your mini-map as well - a second attack is easy to miss once you are defending the first one. Use this tactic to your advantage as well.

items.name: And yet, I lived
items.description: Over one hundred of your units were lost in this battle - even with such great losses, if they were well used against the enemy you did the right thing.  Get used to studying the battle stats after each match with an opponent - did you have the right complementary mix of units?  Did you make your enemy pay for every one of your losses?  Every unit sacrificed is an opportunity to learn about your opponent.

items.name: Massacre
items.description: Two hundred of your units were lost in this conflict.  Sadly, not every battle can be a sweeping victory where everyone returns to the feast table to boast of their skill.   Sometimes, being a good general is about knowing when to throw everything against the enemy without reservation or hesitation.  Today you know how that feels.

items.name: Wololo - Enemy Unit Converted
items.description: Civilizations can be conquered with ideas as surely as with armaments.  You can celebrate your success this battle in converting enemy units.

items.name: Protecting the Priests
items.description: The communication of ideas and religion was a powerful force that changed empires in the Middle Ages.  Your conquest of 20 enemies in a single battle shows great skill at deploying and protecting the priests.

items.name: Master of Conversion
items.description: You have demonstrated mastery of the conversion strategies by converting over fifty enemy units in a single match.

items.name: No Backing Down
items.description: You razed 50 buildings in this campaign, your enemies will think twice before challenging you again.

items.name: Leave No Stone Unburned
items.description: In this campaign you razed over 100 buildings, your name is legend among your enemies.

items.name: Master of the Siege
items.description: No wall nor castle will stand in your way - you have clearly mastered the siege by razing over 250 buildings in one session.

items.name: Live to Rebuild
items.description: For some leaders, losing 15 buildings in a single session would be a reason to retreat and resign.  Not you.

items.name: Phoenix Rising
items.description: For some leaders, losing 50 buildings in a single session would be a crushing defeat - as long as you have wood and villagers you will carry on.

items.name: Live to Fight Another Day
items.description: Some leaders might aspire to build one hundred buildings in their entire reign.  You lost that many this day and fought on valiantly.  Stay strong!

items.name: Creation of your first Wonder of the World
items.description: You have constructed a wonder - a shining pinnacle of achievement for your civilization.  It is a beacon of hope to people everywhere, and if defended - a legacy of that achievement to stand the test of time.

items.name: Five Wonders
items.description: Few leaders can master both the economy needed to construct a wonder, let alone build a strong military or alliances to defend it.  As a veteran of Five Wonders you have demonstrated those skills.

items.name: Will Wonders Never Cease?
items.description: One Wonder is a pinnacle achievement for any ruler.  You have constructed fifty Wonders of the World through your many campaigns through history.  Clearly you are a master of building a strong economy and support structure.  You are clearly a leader in the Age of Empires.

items.name: First Castle Constructed
items.description: The Castle was the premiere fortification of the Medieval period.  Your legacy  in the future is assured.

items.name: Century Castle Celebration
items.description: In your various campaigns through history you have constructed over one hundred castles.

items.name: One Thousand Castles
items.description: On this day you have created your thousand’th castle.  Huzzah!

items.name: William Wallace Campaign Completed
items.description: “We come here with no peaceful intent, but ready for battle, determined to avenge our wrongs and set our country free. Let your masters come and attack us: we are ready to meet them beard to beard.” - (1297) William Wallace

items.name: Joan of Arc Campaign Completed
items.description: “Of the love or hatred God has for the English, I know nothing, but I do know that they will all be thrown out of France, except those who die there.” - Joan of Arc (Trial 1431)

items.name: Saladin Campaign Completed
items.description: By studying the campaigns of Salah al Din Yusuf ibn Ayyub, or 'Saladin' as he was known to the crusaders, you can know that there are many aspects to the great heroes of the Middle Ages. The lessons of his campaigns will guide you in your other conquests.

items.name: Genghis Khan Campaign Completed
items.description: His enemies know only the ruthlessness and speed of the great Khan’s conquests - but the greatest generals also know the tools of cooperation, alliance, and loyalty - these will serve you well in future campaigns.

items.name: Frederick Barbarossa Campaign Completed
items.description: In study of the campaigns of Frederick Barbarossa you learned the power of relics and of uniting an empire. Use this knowledge in your future conquests, but remember not to overextend yourself.

items.name: Attila the Hun Campaign Completed
items.description: Attila knew both great betrayal and great glory in his conquests against the Romans. Attila said: “It takes less courage to criticize the decisions of others than to stand by your own.” - Carry his example on to your other campaigns.

items.name: El Cid Campaign Completed
items.description: Throughout his conquests, El Cid was far more than a master at arms and noble, but was someone who could lead and unite the people. Even beyond his death, the legacy of his leadership was still more powerful than lesser rulers. Take his lessons with you on your own conquests.

items.name: Montezuma Campaign Completed
items.description: By following along with Cuauhtémoc in the battles against Cortés you have used alliance building and subtlety in addition to your skills in battle. Skillful use of forces and alliances can overcome the greatest odds. Remember these lessons in your next conquest.

items.name: Battles of the Conquerors Campaign Completed
items.description: Through study of these diverse battles and leaders you have mastered skills that will be useful in all of your future conquests. Fight with the piety of Charles Martel, the bravery of Alp Arslan, and the calculating tactics of Hideyoshi to ensure success in your campaigns.

items.name: Master of the Medieval World
items.description: You have successfully completed all of the story campaigns of Age of Empires II: The Age of Kings and Age of Empires II: The Conquerors Expansion. Successful leaders use many techniques to build their empires. Your careful study of the greatest of these men and women has given you new powers and abilities to build future empires.

items.name: Lightning General
items.description: You are an expert at the Turbo style, your decision-making under time pressure is legendary.  Congratulations to you, Lightning General!

items.name: Hero of the Spanish
items.description: You have led the Spanish to victory one hundred times! Your name will be listed among their greatest heroes.

items.name: Humanity Victorious
items.description: Congratulations! You have defeated a single CPU opponent (at moderate difficulty or higher).

items.name: Two Challenging
items.description: Congratulations! You have singly defeated two CPU opponents (at moderate difficulty or higher).

items.name: Triumphant Three
items.description: Congratulations! You have singly defeated three CPU opponents (at moderate difficulty or higher).

items.name: Four Scored
items.description: Congratulations! You have singly defeated four CPU opponents (at moderate difficulty or higher).

items.name: Five Golden Victories
items.description: Congratulations! You have singly defeated five CPU opponents (at moderate difficulty or higher).

items.name: Superior Six
items.description: Congratulations! You have singly defeated six CPU opponents (at moderate difficulty or higher).  Not many can claim this level of skill.

items.name: Seven Sealed Fates
items.description: Congratulations! You have singly defeated Seven CPU opponents (at moderate difficulty or higher).  World champions will often play against seven CPU opponents on Hard difficulty as a warm-up before tournaments.

items.name: Power of Persuasion
items.description: Every successful conversion is doubly beneficial to your team - you remove an enemy attacker and increase your own forces.  In your career you have successfully converted fifty units.

items.name: Embracing My Enemies
items.description: Over the span of your career, you have successfully converted over five hundred of your enemies to your cause!

items.name: Converting the World
items.description: You have dedicated yourself to bringing your civilization's religion to your foes.  Very few generals have the patience and wisdom to manage the priest units so effectively as you have.  This is indeed a day of celebration - you have converted one thousand opposing units in your career.

items.name: Burned
items.description: You have crumbled your five hundredth building into rubble…and you are just getting warmed up.   Congratulations!

items.name: Rubble Piles Everywhere
items.description: You have razed five thousand buildings in your long and illustrious military career!  If your reputation went up as quickly as you take buildings down you would be known world-wide.

items.name: No Stone Left Standing
items.description: You have razed ten thousand buildings in your long and illustrious military career!  You can unpack trebuchets in your sleep and you consider a dozen fire archers a pleasant introduction.  You are a legend!

items.name: A Thousand Heaps of Rubble
items.description: In your career you have lost over one thousand buildings.  Everything is a milestone, every win, every loss, and every building that falls.  Great generals count their losses and learn from them.

items.name: Ten Thousand Ruins
items.description: In your career you have lost over ten thousand buildings.  Buildings, like miles spent on horseback are excruciating at first but just mark the passage of time before long.  If you celebrate with a cake, just put one candle on it and start working on your next ten thousand.

items.name: Time to Stop Counting Buildings
items.description: Sure, generals say that every unit lost is mourned and every building razed is avenged - but after fifty thousand even the most obsessive counter gives up.  You have seen civilizatons rise and fall endlessly - it is time to stop counting the buildings.   Congratulations that you persevere, mighty leader.

items.name: Hosted First Game
items.description: You hosted a multiplayer game for the first time!

items.name: Alaric Campaign Completed
items.description: Through toil and perseverance, you have found a new home for Alaric's people, showing even mighty Rome that the Goths are a force to be reckoned with. Use your migratory skills and resilience to find a new home, recover, and succeed in your future aims even when the present looks bleak.

items.name: Dracula Campaign Completed
items.description: Vlad Dracula was a harsh, sometimes cruel ruler, but one could not argue the success of his methods. The only man of his time able to stand against the might of the Ottomans, Vlad showed that patriotism, charisma, and proper tactics could overcome all odds. Vlad also made a point to be strict but fair. Remember that advice when ruling your empire.

items.name: Bari Campaign Completed
items.description: The Nautikos family valued its home greatly, and its family history and heritage instilled a drive in its heirs to bring glory to their house. Their exploits, though somewhat forgotten, are a source of pride to their descendants. That pride is a fine attribute, but it is best tempered with prudence and ethic. Take that advice on your future conquests.

items.name: Sforza Campaign Completed
items.description: Rising from a lowly soldier to Duke of Milan, Sforza did more than make his father’s spirit proud. Use the traits of military leadership and tactics that you have learned in this campaign to find success in your future battles, and remember that it is better to be feared than loved. - Machiavelli (The Prince 1513)

items.name: El Dorado Campaign Completed
items.description: Orellana and his loyal followers faced more than their own fears and superstitions on their navigation of the Amazon. To overcome the adversity that stood in their way, they had to work as a unit and not as individuals. Remember those principles of unity and selflessness on your future campaigns.

items.name: Prithviraj Campaign Completed
items.description: The subject of veneration of many of his descendants, Prithviraj was shrewd, brave, honest, but also prone to emotion, taking many risks for the sake of love. Even in the sight of war and possible death, remember to enjoy your life to the fullest, for you only live once. A complete and moral life deserves the most remembrance.

items.name: Battles of the Forgotten Campaign Completed
items.description: Through your inquiry into the detail of some of the less-known but equally significant historical clashes of arms, you have shown that you are truly a master of the pen and the sword. Rule with the strength of the sons of Ragnar, the diplomatic aptitude of Khosrau Anushirvan, the steadfastness of Minamoto no Yoritomo, and the charisma of Osman Ghazi.

items.name: Master of the Forgotten World
items.description: You have successfully completed all of the story campaigns of Age of Empires II: The Forgotten Expansion. Through your trials and successes in these clashes of arms, you surely have mastered all spheres of empire-building and rule, and are ready to start building your own legend. “Cattle die, kindred die, every man is mortal: But the good name never dies of one who has done well.” -Havamal (Poetic Edda 1220)

items.name: Meet Mick
items.description: You've met Mick. He knows a lot about fighting. You feel a connection between you.

items.name: Meet Apu
items.description: You've met Apu. He's a shop owner. Does he ever sleep?

items.name: Meet Tyler
items.description: You've met Tyler. He looks like a good guy. I think you should spend more time with him.

items.name: Meet Silver
items.description: You've met Silver. He seems arrogant. I hope he'll teach you something.

items.name: Meet Casey
items.description: You've met Casey. He used to be a sailor. Now he can be your employer. I think he is dangerous.

items.name: Prevention of a crime
items.description: You prevented a crime for the first time. I am proud of you!

items.name: Pizza eater
items.description: It tastes good. I see that you like it. But you should probably eat healthier food.

items.name: Spicy pizza
items.description: Mmm... it's so tasty and spicy. I hope I'll try it someday.

items.name: Beat Bill
items.description: It was hard, but you kicked that green ass.

items.name: Beat Mark
items.description: Wow, his staff was really dangerous. But you've won! I could get used to that.

items.name: Beat Gabe
items.description: Passed...Would I be so lucky.

items.name: Beat Steve
items.description: Done! You really did it! Can I call you Dundee now?

items.name: 5th Place
items.description: You've just taken 5th place in the league. Keep going!

items.name: Street fighter
items.description: You did it! You've won 5 times. I always believed in you!

items.name: First fight
items.description: Hm... you've just finished your first fight. Now you feel strange.

items.name: Training results
items.description: Now your shape is better than ever! You look even better than me.

items.name: Ultimate fights
items.description: Now you can fight in the ultimate league. I am a little worried about possible injuries.

items.name: Take the challenge
items.description: The first bloody fight - done!

items.name: Ready to challenge
items.description: Yellow zone - done! Oh my.. I think it's getting really tough now.

items.name: Сrime Fighter
items.description: You've proven yourself as a true defender of your wallet! I think all criminals will avoid you now.

items.name: Trouble in Little China
items.description: There is no more trouble in Little China. No more chinese food for me.

items.name: Big Bobo
items.description: You've met Bobo. And you know what.. for the first time I have to admit that I was wrong.

items.name: The Don
items.description: You've met the Don. I can't even imagine how powerful he is.

items.name: The mobster
items.description: Now you're a part of Bobos gang! May I call you little Bobo now?

items.name: Mickey
items.description: You've met Tyler's brother. He seems like a good guy, but you better be careful if you want to do business with him.

items.name: The silence
items.description: The neighborhood has become so peaceful and calm. But I still won't live here.

items.name: Professional Multi Card
items.description: The card is yours! Now we can earn money with your fists!

items.name: The Sound of Music
items.description: Bobo looks happy as child with his new hearing aid. I hope that he stops shouting now.

items.name: Triple B
items.description: You've beaten Big Bob! He doesn't need your clothes anymore. Now he needs some new teeth!

items.name: Prison Fight
items.description: Everything is arranged except for your pillow.

items.name: King of the Hill
items.description: Crime - prison - kick some ass - freedom !

items.name: Beat Ivangief
items.description: You've avenged your friend! And got the medallion back! Now you can return home.

items.name: The Medallion
